_readme: SEO source of truth. `npm run seo` writes each page's <!-- seo --> head block (title, description, canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD) and regenerates sitemap.xml, robots.txt and llms.txt from this file and assets/data/store.json. Edit here, never in the generated blocks. Only list pages that should be indexed.

org.name: Naga Industries
org.description: Philippine laptop and AI mini PC brand. SIPAG I productivity laptop, LAKAN II gaming laptop and DIWA AI mini PC, which runs Baku, Naga's own local AI. Ships from Manila by DHL Express.

pages.title: Naga Industries | Philippine laptops and AI mini PCs
pages.description: Philippine-built laptops and AI mini PCs. SIPAG I for work, LAKAN II for play, and DIWA, the AI mini PC that runs Baku, our own private AI. Free shipping in the Philippines, $100 flat rate worldwide.

pages.title: LAKAN II gaming laptop: RTX 5060 at 115W, Core 7 250H | Naga
pages.description: NAGA LAKAN II gaming laptop: Intel Core 7 250H, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 at up to 115W, 16GB DDR5 and a 15.6-inch QHD 165Hz display, with the Naga Karga backpack. ₱99,900 (about US$1,580), with local warranty.
pages.imageAlt: NAGA LAKAN II gaming laptop with a cyan-backlit keyboard
pages.productDescription: 15.6-inch gaming laptop with an Intel Core 7 250H processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (8GB GDDR7, up to 115W), 16GB DDR5-5600 memory and a 512GB PCIe Gen4 SSD and a 15.6-inch QHD 165Hz display. Ships with the Naga Karga backpack.

pages.title: SIPAG I productivity laptop: 1.30 kg, up to 13 hours | Naga
pages.description: NAGA SIPAG I productivity laptop in black: Intel Core Ultra 5 125U, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 14-inch Full HD, 60Wh battery for up to 13 hours, 1.30 kg, USB-C charging. Assembled in the Philippines with local warranty.
pages.imageAlt: NAGA SIPAG I productivity laptop with the cyan Naga wallpaper
pages.productDescription: 14-inch Full HD productivity laptop with an Intel Core Ultra 5 125U processor, 16GB DDR5 memory, a 512GB SSD, a 60Wh battery rated for up to 13 hours, USB-C charging and a 1.30 kg metal body.

pages.title: DIWA AI mini PC with Baku, a private local AI | Naga
pages.description: NAGA DIWA is an AI mini PC that runs Baku, Naga's own AI, on the machine. Your data stays private, it works offline and it speaks every language. Coming soon: reserve yours.
pages.imageAlt: NAGA DIWA AI mini PC with a cyan light bar
pages.productDescription: AI mini PC that runs Baku, Naga's own local AI, on the machine: private, offline and multilingual. Coming soon; reservations are open.

extraGraph.description: In Philippine myth the Bakunawa rose from the sea to swallow the moon. Now it lives on your desk: Baku, Naga's own AI, private, offline and speaking every language, only on DIWA.
